title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?

sections.technical: Qilin attracts affiliates to hack into companies and deploy ransomware by offering them at least 80 percent of any extortion amount paid by victims. Searching Intel 471 for Alexbigboss44 reveals this was the Telegram account name shared by the user Rjun on the Russian cybercrime forums Exploit and XSS two years earlier in 2020. The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world s most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. Operating since September 2022, the Russia-based ransomware group Qilin is the currently the most industrious ransomware-as-a-service gang, according to a report (PDF) this month by the cybersecurity firm NCC Group (KrebsOnSecurity profiled the administrator of the second most active ransomware group The Gentlemen in June).

Flashpoint says this user was engaged in high-volume acquisition of Facebook logs and Google Ads accounts to facilitate fraudulent advertising and gambling schemes, and that they functioned as a broker and operator managing a network of traffickers and purchasing compromised data to fuel their operations.

Assessed severity: CRITICAL.
sections.mitigation: The identity threat protection firm Spycloud found the email address mail-30a@mail.ru at one time used the password Rjun132 [Spycloud is also an advertiser on this blog].
